_comment: Named places of India from OpenStreetMap, as points, filed under the State whose outline holds them. Per State four parallel lists sorted south to north then west to east: n (name in Latin letters), k (one letter per place, see kinds), x and y (WGS84 longitude and latitude as integers at coordinate_scale). Generated by infra/aws-central/tools/build-india-localities.mjs. Do not edit by hand.
